column1: # The comparison set: every PDB entry we have a reason to compare against.
# Both inputs are Kameron's: epitopeHLAPositive.csv is the source data, and
# kameron_matches.tsv is his own 11-entry match over it.
# epitope        = the peptide this entry is matched on.
# epitope_source = where that sequence came from. For 7NZF and 8VCX it is NOT in
#   epitopeHLAPositive.csv: Kameron's table lists the CRYSTAL's sequence there and
#   notes the CSV's differing sequence beside it. Those two rows therefore read as
#   'exact' against the crystal while the CSV -- and the AF3 job, which was run on
#   the CSV sequence -- carry a different peptide. Do not read one as the other.
# entity_seq   = the DEPOSITED peptide sequence (the PDB FASTA) -- what was in
#                the crystal, and therefore what a prediction should fold.
# modelled_seq = the residues that actually have COORDINATES -- what an RMSD can
#                be computed over. Disordered termini are absent, so the two
#                differ by 1-7 residues; do not use one where the other is meant.
# modified_res = non-standard residue present (citrulline), mapped to its parent
#                amino acid for pairing. Sequence matches, chemistry does not.
# source: kameron | scan | both. status: include | EXCLUDE (reason in note).
# caveat      = 'dagger' marks a row whose prediction and crystal are NOT the same
#   peptide. It is scored anyway, over the identical positions only, and every
#   figure and table marks it with a dagger. Read `note` before quoting it.

column13: SCORED WITH A CAVEAT. The AF3 job folded wild-type GIAGFKGEQGPKGEP; this crystal is the K->A mutant GIAGFAGEQGPAGEP (2 substitutions, positions 6 and 12). No tether and no other complication -- an ordinary peptide in an ordinary groove. 7NZE/6NIX remain the uncaveated references for that prediction.

SCORED WITH A CAVEAT at Kameron's request. The AF3 job folded the natural insulin sequence GQVELGGGPGAGSLQ; this crystal contains the engineered analog GQVELGGGPGAESCQ (IEDB 2266686, 'PI 40-54 G9E L11C'), which differs at 2 of 15 positions AND is covalently disulfide-bonded to MHC alpha res 72 (2.03 A), so the peptide is held in the groove. Only the 13 identical positions are scored; the number mixes prediction error with the sequence and tethering differences.
